title: Repair worker Git credential propagation and finalization

owned: Per-process Git credential propagation in common.preserve_github_cli_auth_env via GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n>, and GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n> supplying credential.https://github.com.helper = !gh auth git-credential without requiring gh auth setup-git or .gitconfig writes.

Preservation of existing GIT_CONFIG_COUNT entries without loss or renumbering; preservation of explicit GH_CONFIG_DIR, XDG/source HOME discovery, provider alias HOME isolation, and other-host helpers (e.g. gitlab).
Non-interactive prompt-free Git failure via GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 in background worker environments, preventing hangs on terminal input.
Redacted actionable rejection of malformed indexed git configuration.
Protected config delivery in scripts/git/task_finalize.sh: pushing explicitly to origin $TASK_BRANCH without -u (--set-upstream) to eliminate EBUSY writes to read-only shared .git/config.
Real bubblewrap integration test using bind_worker_sandbox with linked task worktree, alias HOME, protected common .git/config, and synthetic gh helper.
Isolated local Git / linked worktree regressions for task_finalize.sh with protected shared config.
Runbook documentation of git credential propagation and protected config delivery architecture in worker-atomic-state-mounts.md.
not_changing: No bypass of bubblewrap isolation or sandbox boundaries.
No writable config overlay or mount relaxation for shared .git/config.
No creation, exposure, or printing of tokens; no call to gh auth token or token caching files.
No alteration to canonical review gates or supervisor merge policy.
composes_with: Supervisor worker runner and provider adapters
scripts/git task lifecycle tools (task_start.sh, worker_commit.py, task_finalize.sh)

failure_reproduction.case_1_ebusy_git_push_u: task_finalize.sh executed 'git push -u origin $TASK_BRANCH', which attempted to write branch upstream tracking to shared .git/config mounted read-only inside worker sandbox, failing with EBUSY / EROFS.
failure_reproduction.case_2_missing_git_credential_helper: Provider alias HOME isolation broke Git credential helper inheritance, and gh auth setup-git could not write read-only HOME/.gitconfig or .git/config, causing Git to interactively prompt for credentials and hang.

implementation.common: Extended preserve_github_cli_auth_env to configure GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, prompt-free GIT_ASKPASS/SSH_ASKPASS, validated indexed git config keys with redacted errors, and per-process Git config (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n>, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n>) for credential.https://github.com.helper = !gh auth git-credential while preserving explicit supported credential policies, caller helper choices including resets, explicit GH_CONFIG_DIR, and other-host helpers.
implementation.task_finalize: Updated line 172 to 'git push origin $TASK_BRANCH' without -u, eliminating writes to shared .git/config while retaining explicit origin push target and failure propagation.
implementation.docs: Updated docs/operations/worker-atomic-state-mounts.md with architecture and runbook details for git credential propagation, protected config delivery, and promotion boundary.
